question: How many HCPs are in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_hcps FROM dim_hcp

question: How many sales territories are there in the West region?
sql: SELECT COUNT(t.territory_id) AS territory_count FROM dim_region r JOIN dim_territory t ON r.region_id = t.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'West'

question: List our own brands and their therapeutic areas.
sql: SELECT brand_name, therapeutic_area FROM dim_product WHERE is_own_brand = 1

question: What is the WAC price of Oncorex?
sql: SELECT wac_price FROM dim_product WHERE brand_name = 'Oncorex'

question: How many oncologists do we have in our HCP universe?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS oncologists FROM dim_hcp WHERE specialty = 'Oncology'

question: What was total TRx for Glucovia in 2025?
sql: SELECT SUM(r.trx) AS total_trx FROM fact_rx r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.brand_name = 'Glucovia' AND r.month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-01'

question: What were total net sales across all our brands last quarter?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.net_sales), 2) AS total_net_sales FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = s.month WHERE p.is_own_brand = 1 AND c.year_quarter = '2026-Q3'

question: How many calls did reps make in September 2026?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls FROM fact_call WHERE call_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

question: Which payers are in the Medicare channel?
sql: SELECT payer_name FROM dim_payer WHERE channel = 'Medicare'

question: When did Oncorex launch?
sql: SELECT launch_date FROM dim_product WHERE brand_name = 'Oncorex'

question: How many reps are on the Specialty team?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rep_id) AS specialty_team_reps FROM dim_rep WHERE sales_team = 'Specialty'

question: What were gross sales of Pulmova in 2024?
sql: SELECT SUM(s.gross_sales) AS gross_sales FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = s.month WHERE p.brand_name = 'Pulmova' AND c.year = 2024

question: How many HCPs are in decile 10?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hcp_count FROM dim_hcp WHERE decile = 10

question: How many HCPs are on the call plan?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hcp_id) AS hcp_count FROM dim_hcp WHERE is_target = 1

question: How many new prescriptions has Neurolin had so far this year?
sql: SELECT SUM(r.nrx) AS nrx FROM fact_rx r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.brand_name = 'Neurolin' AND r.month BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-01'

question: Which competitor brands are in the Diabetes market?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.brand_name FROM dim_product p JOIN fact_rx r ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE p.is_own_brand = 0 AND p.therapeutic_area = 'Diabetes'

question: How many virtual calls were made in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS virtual_calls FROM fact_call WHERE channel = 'Virtual' AND call_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: How many units of Cardiozen were shipped in 2026-Q2?
sql: SELECT SUM(s.units) AS units_shipped FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = s.month WHERE p.brand_name = 'Cardiozen' AND c.year_quarter = '2026-Q2'

question: What is the Glucovia quota for the Atlanta territory in 2026-Q4?
sql: SELECT q.target_net_sales AS glucovia_quota FROM fact_quota q JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = q.product_id JOIN dim_territory t ON t.territory_id = q.territory_id WHERE p.brand_name = 'Glucovia' AND t.territory_name = 'Atlanta' AND q.year_quarter = '2026-Q4'

question: What were Glucovia net sales by region last quarter?
sql: SELECT g.region_name, ROUND(SUM(s.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN dim_territory t ON t.territory_id = s.territory_id JOIN dim_region g ON g.region_id = t.region_id WHERE p.brand_name = 'Glucovia' AND s.month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY g.region_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: Show monthly Cardiozen TRx for 2026 so far.
sql: SELECT c.month, SUM(r.trx) AS trx FROM fact_rx r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = r.month WHERE p.brand_name = 'Cardiozen' AND c.year = 2026 GROUP BY c.month ORDER BY c.month

question: What were net sales by brand in 2025, highest first?
sql: SELECT p.brand_name, ROUND(SUM(s.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE s.month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.brand_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: How many calls did each sales team make last quarter?
sql: SELECT rp.sales_team, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM fact_call fc JOIN dim_rep rp ON rp.rep_id = fc.rep_id WHERE fc.call_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rp.sales_team ORDER BY calls DESC

question: Which payers list Glucovia as non-preferred or do not cover it?
sql: SELECT py.payer_name, f.coverage_status FROM formulary f JOIN dim_payer py ON py.payer_id = f.payer_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id WHERE p.brand_name = 'Glucovia' AND (f.coverage_status = 'Non-Preferred' OR f.coverage_status = 'Not Covered')

question: What was total TRx by therapeutic area in 2025?
sql: SELECT p.therapeutic_area, SUM(r.trx) AS total_trx FROM fact_rx r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.month BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-01' GROUP BY p.therapeutic_area

question: What is the call frequency per reached HCP for Neurolin this year?
sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT fc.hcp_id), 2) AS calls_per_hcp FROM fact_call fc JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = fc.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = fc.call_date WHERE p.brand_name = 'Neurolin' AND c.year = 2026

question: Which rep made the most calls in 2025?
sql: SELECT rp.first_name, rp.last_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count FROM fact_call fc JOIN dim_rep rp ON rp.rep_id = fc.rep_id WHERE fc.call_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY rp.rep_id, rp.first_name, rp.last_name ORDER BY call_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct HCPs prescribed Oncorex in 2026-Q3?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.hcp_id) AS hcp_count FROM fact_rx r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = r.month WHERE p.brand_name = 'Oncorex' AND c.year_quarter = '2026-Q3'

question: What is the gross-to-net discount for each of our brands year to date?
sql: SELECT p.brand_name, ROUND(100.0 * (1 - SUM(s.net_sales) / SUM(s.gross_sales)), 1) AS gtn_pct FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE s.month BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-09-01' AND p.is_own_brand = 1 GROUP BY p.brand_name

question: What were Neurolin net sales by quarter in 2025?
sql: SELECT c.year_quarter, ROUND(SUM(s.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN dim_calendar c ON c.month = s.month WHERE p.brand_name = 'Neurolin' AND c.year = 2025 GROUP BY c.year_quarter ORDER BY c.year_quarter

question: Break down Glucovia TRx by prescriber specialty for last quarter.
sql: SELECT h.specialty, SUM(r.trx) AS trx FROM fact_rx r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN dim_hcp h ON h.hcp_id = r.hcp_id WHERE p.brand_name = 'Glucovia' AND r.month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-01' GROUP BY h.specialty ORDER BY trx DESC

question: How many calls has the Primary Care team made by channel so far in 2026?
